simulation.success: Collect exact provider deployment commit, full build logs and image digest; admit build only. Proceed to separate installed-runtime/hosted gates.
simulation.failure: Preserve first real failure and logs; do not skip failing tests or automatically replay. Bounded repair on PR501 and fresh exact-source admission.
simulation.interruption: Reconcile staged patch/deployment workflow before retry. Never apply unrelated environment changes.
simulation.rollback: Before apply, leave staged without deployment or revert only these own fields. After apply, restore recorded prior source/config through approved controls; customer deployment and data untouched.
